fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole bass boat with trailer; some photos are dealer showroom shots of a new comparison boat, but the seller's own boat appears in the hangar and driveway photos.
findings: Hull paint on the seller's boat in the driveway photo looks glossy with no visible oxidation or dullness
Deck carpet and seats in the hangar photo look clean and uncluttered
Several photos appear to be of a different new boat in a dealer showroom, so only two photos show the seller's actual boat and they are fairly distant
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Vexus VTX and it looks like it has been kept in great shape, with a glossy hull in the driveway shot and a clean deck in the hangar. If you'd like it looking its best for showings, we do a pre-sale wash and wax that comes to you. Would you like a quote?
